shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air + faux-perspective depth, cross-level work/hauling/medical/recreation/modded-needs, DIRECT cross-level utilities (power, DBH, VEF/Helixien/VTE, Rimefeller), stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection/compile-time refs with clean signatures (foreign types in method BODIES only — the TypeLoadException rule; ENFORCED 2026-07-19 across all four foreign refs — BadHygiene, 0DubCore, PipeSystem, Rimefeller). Name-based registrations verified against shipped assemblies.
- **Detection is postfix-insensitive (2026-07-20)**: ALL soft-compat activity checks go through ABDetect.Active (ModLister.GetActiveModWithIdentifier ignorePostfix) — raw ModsConfig.IsActive misses local copies of workshop mods (the _steam suffix split; found live when the user localized Rimefeller: XML FindMod kept applying by NAME while the C# bridge died silently). 11 call sites across 8 compat modules converted in one pass.
- **HarmonyBoot filters on [HarmonyPatch] (2026-07-20)**: only annotated classes reach CreateClassProcessor (all 37 patch classes are class-level-annotated; verified no method-level-only patterns). Unfiltered processing walked bridge method lists and produced the scary "Skipped patch class RimefellerBridge: Could not resolve type 'Rimefeller.PipelineNet'" warning that external log triage blamed on us. GetTypes guarded against ReflectionTypeLoadException (would otherwise kill EVERY patch). Both lessons in user lore.
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid rock, thick-roofed, 12C. Conservative animal policy. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or deconstruct. VERIFIED.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase (0.6x quality-scaled), elevator (0.35x two-hop). Climb = Building_ABStairs.BaseClimbTicks (90) x type x quality x slider. Landing platforms footprint+1, air-reversion exempt.
- Stairs carry PAWNS ONLY (tickerType Never, no comps). All utilities cross through dedicated utilityOnly links.

## DIRECT cross-level utilities (replaces the battery/tank equalization model)
- **Vanilla power — vertical conduit**: CompABGridLink : CompPowerTrader (transmitsPower, 0 base consumption). Master side (lower map uniqueID) recomputes every 15t: measures both nets excluding all AB links (live gain in watts, off-but-wanting consumer demand via Props.PowerConsumption, battery room), nets a single signed flow, sets PowerOutput +/- on the pair. Deficits served from far generation surplus AND far stored energy; leftover generation (never battery charge) tops up far batteries. Parallel conduits converge by subtracting other links' promised flow. No storage, no efficiency loss, no player battery needed. **Rimatomics electricity rides vanilla PowerNet, so it crosses through the conduit automatically** (its internal steam/coolant nets unverified — mod not installed).
- **VEF PipeSystem — vertical duct** (covers Vanilla Pipes Expanded, Helixien gas, VTE ACNet, any PipeNetDef): net pairs matched by def at the duct cell or cardinal neighbor; unmet demand (live + off-but-CanBeOn receivers) injected via PipeNet.ExtraProduction/ExtraConsumptionThisTick (public hooks, consumed once per 100t net tick — ordering-safe). No storage needed on either side. Secondary damped tank equalization. Duct carries no VEF comps; def gated by PatchOperationFindMod. Helper signatures object-typed.
- **DBH — vertical water pipe**: each end carries DBH CompPipe(Water) + hidden 100L CompWaterStorage, so the shaft IS a tower on both nets (wells/pumps fill it via DBH's own CompTick; fixtures drink from it — tankless levels work). Damped fill-fraction equalization via PullWater/PushWater. Sewage stays per-level (documented limitation).
- **Rimefeller — vertical chem pipe (RE-AUDITED 2026-07-20 against workshop 1.6 DLL)**: each end carries two hidden 100-unit CompStorageTank comps (Oil + Fuel); oil and fuel fill fractions equalize via PullOil(double)/PushCrude(double)/PullFuel(double)/PushFuel(float) — all members verified present in Rimefeller 1.6 (PipelineNet.OilStorage/FuelStorage, CompProperties_StorageTank.Contents/StorageCap, TankClass enum). Bridge is compile-time-proven against the exact DLL the csproj references (workshop 1321849735\1.6). A LOCAL copy of the same build resolves identically (assembly binds by simple name "Rimefeller"). The screenshot'd "Could not resolve type" log line was the pre-2026-07-19 signature-violation symptom, now impossible (signatures object-typed AND HarmonyBoot never touches bridges). Def patch gated by name-based FindMod (local-copy-proof).
- Dispatcher ABPipeCompat: ABDetect flags, per-def ext routing (bridgeWater/bridgeVef/bridgeChem), driven from ground LevelComp every 100t (VEF cadence).

## Sky surface model (round-15, VERIFIED runs #121-#123)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule + sweep (TIME-SLICED: 4096 cells/tick; full sweep only at load).
- **Rooftop visual (VERIFIED #121)**: AB_RoofSurface renders with the VANILLA steel tile texture (Terrain/Surfaces/GenericFloorTile) tinted dark steel (0.32,0.32,0.32). Tiles to the OUTER wall edge, roofed doorways covered, zero below bleed-through, sky things/floors on top.
- Decisions locked with user: steel tile look for ALL constructed roofs; freestanding unroofed walls stay visible from above; rooftop keeps FULL buildability (Light/Medium/Heavy).
- **Mountain edge (VERIFIED #123)**: below rock sits under natural roof mapped to AB_MountainTop by the genstep. Fog-mirroring pair: printed below-things layer prints under BOTH air and cap cells but only UNFOGGED lower things; cap layer SKIPS flat fill on cells whose below cell holds an explored rock face. Exploring below live-updates the sky view.
- **Sky auto-roof guard**: RoofSync-gated prefix on AutoBuildRoofAreaSetter.TryGenerateAreaNow — sky rooms bordering AB_OpenAir count as touching the map edge; fully walled sky rooms auto-roof normally.

## See-below renderer (round-16: printed things + faux perspective + slab skirt + fake zoom out)
- **Things content is PRINTED PER CELL, not cloned**: SectionLayer_ABBelowThings on the sky map reprints the lower map's map-mesh things for cells that are AB_OpenAir OR AB_MountainTop, skipping lower-FOGGED cells. Covered cells print nothing — roof opacity BY CONSTRUCTION. Drawn at forced band queues via LevelRenderer.DrawBelowSubMesh (queue stepped by submesh altitude x14).
- **Faux-perspective depth transform**: ENTIRE below view (clone band + printed things via shared BelowMatrix, mirrored dynamic pass via ApplyDrawShift in the DrawPos postfix) draws through p' = k*p + (1-k)*cam + (0, BelowOffset, -depthShift). Fixed south shift slider (belowDepthShift 0-0.6, default 0.25, VERIFIED); OPT-IN camera parallax (belowParallax, default OFF; strength 0.1-0.8 default 0.35; k = 1 - strength/RootSize, clamped >= 0.8). Mask stays untransformed by design.
- **Slab-edge skirt (VERIFIED)**: dark steel side faces (0.16,0.17,0.19; Transparent shader clone at BelowQueueCeiling-60) on AIR cells bordering slab (= sky terrain neither air nor mountain-cap). South faces height = depth shift (floored 0.08) — exact 2.5D extrusion; E/W 0.08 outlines; north nothing; cap borders excluded. Rebuilds inside the mask job (sync+async). Toggle drawSlabEdge default ON.
- **Fake zoom out (AWAITING VERIFICATION)**: below objects draw smaller (belowThingScale 0.7-1.0, default 0.85). Printed things: per-thing vert scaling about TrueCenter after each Print (linked graphics excluded — walls/fences/conduits/rock would gap at cell boundaries). Live pawns: postfix on PawnRenderer.GetDrawParms right-multiplies PawnDrawParms.matrix by Scale(s,1,s) when OffsetActive; prefix on ParallelGetPreRenderResults sets disableCache=true (far-zoom atlas blit ignores parms.matrix). Slider reprints live via WholeMapChanged(AB_BelowThings). Doors/projectiles/motes stay 1.0.
- **Rooftop rim wall reveal (round-17, THIRD-PASS FIX after #132, AWAITING RE-VERIFICATION)**: SectionLayer_ABWallReveal — rim rooftop cells (AB_RoofSurface over a CoveredBelow-qualifying artificial impassable edifice, >=1 cardinal sky neighbor AB_OpenAir) reprint the supporting wall clipped to the air-facing strip (slider wallRevealWidth 0.25-0.6 default 0.5; width baked into verts — slider reprints via DirtyBelowThingsLayers). Clip = print-time quad rewrite (corner-matched bilinear uv/color remap; verts flattened to FloorEmplacement altitude; shadow-material + malformed submeshes dropped). **ORDERING (the hard-won part, 2 failures documented in code + user lore)**: draw via clones at LevelRenderer.WallRevealQueue = max(terrain-family materials: Soil/RoofSurface/MountainTop/MetalTile/WoodPlank)+1 HARD-CLAMPED Min(cutout-1) — the mountain cap's proven window. FAILED #131: EdgeShadow in the measurement (transparent-range queue) + no hard clamp -> strips above cutout -> painted over sky walls. FAILED #132: native materials + low altitude ("camera distance sorts within queue") -> map shaders don't depth-write; same-queue = submission order; our layer draws after ThingsGeneral -> strips over sky wall face again. Worst case now = strips hidden under steel (safe direction). Toggle drawWallReveal default ON. Limitations: doorway rims plain; fogged-below rims plain.
- **Slab-edge wall facade (round-17, FIXED after #131 — shadow drop verified no-black-bars in #132, core visual AWAITING VERIFICATION)**: SectionLayer_ABWallFacade — slab cells (skirt's IsSlab rule) with south sky neighbor AB_OpenAir and qualifying below edifice reprint that wall whole; drawn IDENTITY + Translate south by max(belowDepthShift, 0.08) (draw-time, slider live) at BelowQueueCeiling-55 (above skirt -60, below all sky materials). Sky terrain covers the over-slab part — only the sliver over the air cell survives; skirt behind covers doorway/no-wall spans. Post-print ABRimPrint.DropUnsafeNewGeometry drops ShadowGraphic volumes (uv-less SunShadowFade meshes that rendered as the #131 "black heavy borders" and could poison FinalizeMesh). Identity-anchored like the skirt BY DECISION. Toggle drawWallFacade default ON.
- Shared: ABRimPrint (support predicate mirroring CoveredBelow's edifice branch + drawer check; snapshot/rollback/truncate; IsShadowMaterial + DropUnsafeNewGeometry). Both layers key on AB_BelowThings|Terrain flags, sky map only, ABGuard.Rendering kill switch, build-always + Visible-gated draw (instant toggles = live bisection tool).
- **Regen triggers**: MapMeshFlagDef AB_BelowThings mirrored per cell from lower-map dirty events (postfix on MapDrawer.MapMeshDirty -> LevelSync.OnLowerMeshDirty; Things|Buildings|FogOfWar; adjacent mirror). Sky Terrain flag too. Cap layer subscribes as well. Skirt follows within the mask's 15-frame window.
- Clone band: flat ground layers only (Terrain 300, EdgeShadows 260, Sand 285, TerrainEdges 280, TerrainScatter 275, SunShadows 255, BridgeProps 250, Snow 90, Gas 85, Pollution 80). BelowQueueCeiling = MIN across terrain families, measured live. Watergen excluded + lower.waterInfo.SetTextures() per frame. One-way mirror dynamic pass (native queues, unroofed+unfogged+air-above). Async mask+skirt rebuild under ABGuard.Async. Zero cost when the sky map is not current.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker.
- NEEDS ACROSS THE COLUMN: rest, food, RECREATION, NEED/STATE ENGINE (two tiers: normal + MENTAL-SAFE with faction+humanlike filter). Built-ins: vanilla BingeDrug/BingeFood/Berserk/MurderousRage mental-safe; RJW family; Intimacy. Public: ABApi.RegisterNeedJobGiver(name, allowInMentalState). Shared ABPawnCooldown helper.
- Medical rescue three ways; capture; one-colony UI; ABPendingOrders.

## Performance architecture (post 8-tranche pass)
- **Scheduling**: ALL LevelComp cadences use elapsed-time nextDue scheduling, never TicksGame modulo. Weather 150t, pipes 100t, climate 250t, hostile scan 250t (pocket), sweep 2000t + 4096 cells/tick slices, power 15t.
- **Hidden-level throttling**: weather x4, sweep x5 while not current, catch-up on visibility edge. Dirty mirror accumulates flags while hidden.
- **Colonist bar**: reorder postfix mirrors entriesDirty; comparator keys precomputed.
- Faux-perspective transform + thing scale: one lazy per-frame rebuild. Skirt piggybacks the mask job. Scale is print-time-only for baked content. Rim reveal + facade are perimeter-only geometry keyed on existing flags. Zero when no sky map is current. Zero recurring cost with no levels.

## T7 optimizer-conflict audit (2026-07-19, all five active mods decompiled)
- Performance Optimizer: disjoint targets. WATCH: Optimization_Pawn_DrawPos frame-cache composes with our Priority.Last offset postfix. NEW WATCH: nothing currently caches GetDrawParms/pre-render results.
- Missile Girl: no overlap. Performance Esmolas: WATCH MothballCache (behavioral only). Slower Pawn Tick Rate: compatible. Dubs Analyzer: profiler only. **Zero patch-target collisions.**

## Originality audit (2026-07-19, extended 2026-07-20)
- MultiFloors: shared idea only. Z-Levels beta: per-cell print filter idea shared (user-directed reference), implementation independent; camera-parallax term, slab-edge skirt, per-object fake zoom out, and the round-17 rim reveal/facade pair (print-time quad clipping + roof-as-clip-mask + clamped-queue-window ordering) are ours alone. No foreign code or assets anywhere.

## T8 threats + pocket NPC movement (VERIFIED)
- Diversion at execution; pocket incident redirect (ABIncidentLevelPolicy opt-in); pocket NPC scan (hostiles descend + assault-join; friendlies with exit duties get exit lords; never insects/vehicles).

## World integration (done)
- Tile identity; column wealth (ON); cross-level caravans; column trade; settlement-loss warning + native pocket destruction.

## T11 mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes (direct), DBH (direct + tankless), Rimefeller (direct-ish, re-audited), Open The Windows (VERIFIED #118), Vehicle Framework, Hospitality, Common Sense, RJW, Intimacy, Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter. ALL detections postfix-insensitive via ABDetect.
- INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. Watch: Perspective Shift, airship traders, Real Ruins, gravships, Rimatomics steam/coolant nets.

## T12 open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver.
- XML: ABStairsExtension (deltaLevel, counterpartDef, climbFactor, utilityOnly, bridgeWater, bridgeVef, bridgeChem); ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip (REDUCED by depth shift); no below water depth shading; mined-floor hard edges; async mask lag on fast pans; no below damage scratches. Freestanding unroofed walls below visible from above (locked).
- Faux perspective + skirt + scale: north-side pawns tuck further under the roof edge; fog-edge terrain sliver; parallax corner misalignment (~2x strength); sub-cell water sampling shift. Skirt: flat color, corner notch, 15-frame lag, pawns draw in front. Scale: linked structures + doors stay life-size next to shrunk objects; blob shadows unscaled; far-zoom below humanlikes skip the atlas cache.
- Rim reveal/facade: doorway rims plain (steel tile / skirt face only — doors never print); fogged-below rims plain; facade detaches slightly from the slab edge under camera parallax (skirt-class limitation); south rim cells show wall top strip AND facade face adjacent (the "thick wall" read — judged in-game); rim things drop their sun shadow volumes by design; strips invisible (under steel) if a terrain family ever measures >= cutout-1 (deliberate safe-failure direction).
- Systems: bill radius vs stairs; couples-as-singles alert; restaurants per-level; doctor pile-on; sweep-cadence wall edits.
- Utilities: DBH sewage per-level; VEF turn-on cascade; hidden sky weather lag; old saves drop removed battery keys.
- Open The Windows: platform-rim windows dark (porch behavior); basement windows never outside; pre-guard decks need one manual remove-roof; OTW one-shot null-region warning (theirs).
- T8: mounted raiders never descend; basement insects stay. World: caravan items surface-only; purchases drop at surface.
- Six comp-guard boilerplate sites still long-form.

## Status
Round-17 rim depth pair: reveal ordering fixed THIRD PASS after #132 (clamped cap-window queue clones; both failed approaches documented in code + user lore: EdgeShadow-poisoned measurement, and the false "altitude sorts within queue" assumption). Facade shadow fix held in #132 (no black bars reported). Compile-green, awaiting re-verification of: reveal-under-sky-walls, facade continuity, width slider, fake zoom out. Then: Rimefeller compat run, T9 soak, T5 publishing prep.
